source: Trader-provided FVG transcript, closed-world trade screenshot/video corpus, frozen 14-case replay, and explicit trader clarifications through 2026-08-20

detector_authority.rule: Use the existing native detector; do not maintain a second strategy-specific FVG detector.

fvg_identity.bullish: third candle low is strictly above first candle high
fvg_identity.bearish: third candle high is strictly below first candle low
fvg_identity.zone_boundaries: wick-to-wick price band between candle one and candle three
fvg_identity.active_gap: formed and not subsequently re-entered/mitigated on a completed later 15m bar

trader_target_rule.purpose: FVG is one possible take-profit reaction destination and may also be a causal support/resistance interaction band; it is never an automatic trade.
trader_target_rule.fvg_take_profit: middle of the selected active 15m FVG, tick rounded conservatively
trader_target_rule.fvg_edge_reaction_boundary: The trader may use the relevant end/edge of the FVG as the support/resistance reaction boundary when that FVG is the physical structure immediately before the next structural S/R.
trader_target_rule.liquidity_cluster_take_profit: the selected meaningful liquidity/reaction cluster TP level/interior defined by the existing structural target geometry
trader_target_rule.normal_tp1_rule: The nearest meaningful physical S/R reaction, liquidity/reaction cluster, or active FVG owns TP1. No farther feature may leapfrog it merely for more room.
trader_target_rule.tp_display_safe_gap_rule: At the frozen 15-MNQ reference display, planned TP1 reward >= $400 is safe enough for direct entry if every other A+ gate passes; planned reward under $400 blocks the immediate entry.
trader_target_rule.processed_reaction_continuation_exceptio: A later candidate may target the next meaningful destination only when that candidate itself earns an already-approved continuation through the same TP1 reaction area; unrelated earlier entry locations may not claim TP1 was processed.
trader_target_rule.retired_rule: The prior Params.min_room_r * Params.stop automatic TP1-to-TP2 rollover interpretation is superseded and forbidden for the trader's planned TP display gap.
trader_target_rule.target_only_15m_zone_rule: An active established 15m structural S/R zone with at least 2 independent rejections and quality>=min_zone_quality remains a meaningful TP/blocker even when it lacks the confluence or high_zone_quality required to authorize a fresh entry.

fvg_support_resistance_interaction.bearish_from_resistance_fvg: price must reject the FVG resistance band and then prove bearish 5m candle story plus sustained bearish live force
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.bullish_through_resistance_fvg: price must disrespect/clear the opposing FVG resistance band under the normal breakout confirmation plus sustained bullish live force
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.bullish_from_support_fvg: price must reject the FVG support band and then prove bullish 5m candle story plus sustained bullish live force
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.bearish_through_support_fvg: price must disrespect/clear the opposing FVG support band under the normal breakout confirmation plus sustained bearish live force
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.normal_breakout_confirmation: first completed 5m print beyond the band is setup only; following forming 5m must extend beyond the first breakout candle directional extreme and prove sustained force
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.intraday_fvg_refresh: Only completed active 15m FVGs known at the start of each forming 5m bucket may participate; future/incomplete 15m FVGs are forbidden.

video_entry_filters.adoption_rule: Do not silently import unrelated creator checklist thresholds. Only the trader-confirmed current-strategy FVG identity, TP role, support/resistance interaction, rejection/clearance behavior and causal timing are executable authority.
